records.rationale: The description concretely specifies accessibility functions—speech and Braille output and navigation/access to applications. It does not describe learned or AI-based speech generation; these stated screen-reader functions support a conventional description-based negative.
evidence_spans: JAWS provides speech and Braille output for the most popular computer applications on your PC.
You will be able to navigate the Internet, write a document, read an email and create presentations
records.conflict_response: The stated speech output does not by itself establish AI dependence, and I do not assume that speech synthesis is always conventional or always AI. Since the text gives clear accessibility functionality but no AI signal or unexplained AI-dependent operation, the negative is supported under the description-only rubric.

records.rationale: Enterprise-application access and integration are concrete, but the claimed analytics are not explained and could use differing methods. The text supports non-AI only weakly; the appended annual-price module label does not clarify functionality.
evidence_spans: eliminates the complexity of accessing and integrating enterprise application including SAP ERP and SAP CRM, Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Oracle PeopleSoft, enabling agile analytics that produce tangible business outcomes.
records.conflict_response: The concrete integration language supports a conventional function, but 'agile analytics' has no specified method, so absence of an AI mention is not enough to resolve it as a supported negative. The annual-price module text supplies no functional detail. I preserve weak/forced non-AI rather than infer either AI or a particular analytics implementation.

records.rationale: The offering is described as training content packs containing demonstrations, simulations, job aids and assessments, plus a kit to customize or create content. These are conventional instructional-content functions; no AI operation is described.
evidence_spans: Our ART Content Packs contain Show-Me demonstrations, Hands-On Try-Me simulations, step-by-step job aids and assessments.
Use the ART Developer Kit to customize the Content Pack or create your own content for your Learning Management System (LMS) and Webserver.
records.conflict_response: The description explicitly frames the offering as content packs and content customization, with examples of the material supplied. It does not establish how the simulations run or that the developer kit is included, and I do not infer either point; the stated instructional-content function is nevertheless meaningful conventional functionality.

records.rationale: Monitoring and consolidating infrastructure data are concrete conventional functions, but the method for automated discovery, analytics, and remediation is unspecified. Non-AI is the best-supported forced decision, with unresolved analytics/automation uncertainty.
evidence_spans: monitors your IT environment and consolidates data from existing tools.
It applies automated discovery, monitoring, analytics, and remediation to data across traditional, private, public, multi-cloud and container-based infrastructure.
records.conflict_response: I do not treat automation as AI, nor do I treat the absence of an AI word as proof. The conventional monitoring/consolidation is clear, while the generic analytics and unspecified discovery/remediation method leave a plausible implementation ambiguity; therefore this remains weak/forced rather than a supported negative.

records.rationale: The text identifies fixed-fee software managed services but states no software function, so it cannot substantiate a supported negative. Non-AI is retained only as the forced best-supported binary decision.
evidence_spans: Verint fixed fee software managed services.
records.conflict_response: Agreement between the proposals is not evidence. The single sentence names a service arrangement without describing what the software does; no AI signal is present, but the missing functional detail leaves the decision weak and forced.
